description: This file defines the CategoryEntity class, which extends the Category class and implements Serializable. It adds additional properties such as sortOrder, visible, code, and lineage, with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: CategoryEntity
classes.description: A Java class that extends Category, representing a category entity with serialization capabilities and additional attributes like sortOrder, visible, code, and lineage.
